scope: Proposition 5.7 (Translated copies and defect flow) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 73. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a choice of exact twisted maps with the following properties. On every shift-good support the twisted activity is exactly the untwisted activity at the local lifted translate. For k ≤ 2 at every scale, or for arbitrary fixed k with source separations at least ϵM at scales S = Lm ≤ cϵM/(k + 1), (5.22) the full defect norm vj satisfies vj+1 ≤ θvj + C(uj + wj) + C(uj + wj + vj)2 , vj ≤ Czρj 2, ρ1 < ρ2 < 1. (5.23) The constants in the decaying regime are independent of k under (5.22). For each fixed k, ϵ, the remaining bounded number of scales preserve an o(1) bound as M → ∞. Consequently, after extracting the designated scalar factors, the twisted terminal partition average tends to one uniformly for separated interior configurations.
